Description:
Yūta Yamano had a pure relationship with his older childhood friend, Natsuka Shinomiyako, who was his girlfriend.
Though Natsuka used to be prudish, even disliking dirty jokes, Yūta had noticed she'd become strangely proactive lately. Summer holidays began, and the two finally experienced their first time together.

However, Natsuka found she couldn't be satisfied with just being with Yūta. That very same day, she summoned a guy notorious for being a womaniser...
